By leveraging a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can establish a fully operational online store and keep more of your earnings. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms often impose high fees, such as Gumroad's 10% cut on every sale. In contrast, using NOWPayments for processing your transactions incurs only a 0.5% fee. This significant difference means that if you sell 100 products priced at $97 each, you retain an extra $921. Additionally, this infrastructure allows you to bypass restrictions imposed by conventional platforms, providing you with true sovereignty over your digital commerce operations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few essential components. Start with a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your site for free. You'll also need backend logic capability, which can be achieved through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. For order storage, consider using Supabase or Google Sheets, and utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Lastly, integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing and to ensure automatic delivery of your digital products.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment method with NOWPayments to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. You'll set up a webhook to trigger automatic payment verification once a customer completes a transaction. Next, integrate your delivery system, ensuring files are automatically sent to customers upon successful payment. This process can be streamlined using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, allowing you to focus on creating high-quality digital products without worrying about manual order fulfillment.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with low transaction fees using NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is ready, it's time to go live. Publish your site and test your payment and delivery pipeline with a small transaction. Ensure that all integrations function correctly and that customers receive their products as expected. This initial transaction will help you identify any potential issues before launching to a broader audience. Monitor your sales and customer feedback to refine your processes and enhance your offerings continuously.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your sovereign digital commerce stack in place, you can begin scaling your operations. Start by adding more digital products to your store; this could include ebooks, courses, templates, and more. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that simplify your scaling efforts. As your sales grow, take advantage of the low transaction fees associated with NOWPayments to maximize your profits, ensuring that you maintain complete control over your business.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes a free hosting service, a backend solution, and crypto payment processing through NOWPayments. This eliminates reliance on conventional platforms and reduces transaction fees significantly, allowing you to keep more of your profits.
Maintain complete ownership of your data and infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose a free hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Implement backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Test your payment and delivery systems with a small transaction. Publish your site and start selling digital products.
